lines.zh: 一蹦，比普通兔子远得多。
lines.en: One hop carries me far past a normal rabbit.
My ears sweep through the grass.
My hind legs kick, and dust lifts.
I clear that little ditch.
Big body, heavy landings.
The grass here is tender, so I wander.
My long ears swivel forward and back.
I stop to nibble a couple of bites.
The stems snap in my mouth.
I work around the edge of the meadow.
One bound and a patch of grass flattens.
The wind on the plain is soft.
I slow down to catch my breath.
My tail is too short to notice.
I change direction and keep wandering.
There is enough meadow for a whole day.
I sit and my ears keep moving.
My nose never stops twitching.
The sun on my back feels good.
I am only a little bigger than usual.
The grass tastes slightly sweet.
I shake the grass seed off my coat.
There is a burrow; I look at it.
There is grass enough. No rush.
Grass seeds cling to my fur.
I flick my long ears.
There are no predators around here.
I grind my back teeth.
The wind dies and the insects start.
I look up at the sky.
Nothing to do. Back to eating.
The grass here is thicker than elsewhere.
You are quite a lot taller than me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻子还在动。
lines.en: I look up at you, nose still working.
You are not holding grass, are you?

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，耳朵没贴背。
lines.en: I look up at you, ears not yet flat.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵听得清你的脚步。
lines.en: My ears hear your footsteps clearly.
You stand still, and I watch.
Let us each go our own way.
What are you laughing at?
I hop two steps off, then look back.
I was on this grass first.
You want to pet me? Wait a moment.
I am only a big rabbit.
I bolt a good distance away.
My ears are flat against my back.
That hurt. I need to run.
Do not hit me!
My hind legs have gone weak.
A tuft of fur came loose.
I am not a monster.
Blood drips onto the grass.
I am huffing and puffing.
I stop and give you one look.
Carrot? That is different.
That smells better than grass.
I am hopping over.
Set it down slowly; do not startle me.
I will not grab. I will wait.
That bite is sweet enough.
Once you turn away, I'll start.
How about one more?

lines.zh: 嘴里叼着，眼睛还盯着你。
lines.en: With it in my mouth, my eyes stay on you.
My belly makes the decision.
This is far better than grass.
When I finish, I will want more.
I nudge your boot with my nose.
I could follow you for a while.
Lower your hand and I'm coming.
Fine. I will trust you once.
One hop and I bump your leg.

lines.zh: 你被我这分量顶了一下。
lines.en: My weight nudges you.
I brake hard with my hind legs.
The bump set me swaying too.
You held; I am fine.
Between us we have trampled the grass.
I hop around you and go on.
That was not too heavy, was it?
My ears got knocked askew.
Next time I will hop wider.
I drum the ground with my hind legs.
Over there, did you hear that?
We crouch side by side.
Ear against ear.
There is room on this grass for the little ones.
If something moves, we bolt together.
Let me deepen the burrow first.
Quietly; do not startle anyone.

lines.zh: 同一片草原，同一个方向。
lines.en: One meadow, one direction.
There will be big rabbits every year.
I test it with the tips of my teeth.
One nudge of my nose and it rolls away.
Let me try one bite.
Not good. I spit it out.
I sniff at that stuff on the ground.
I push it behind the bushes.
This thing is hard.
It is not grass, so I do not want it.
Tuck it by my cheek and chew slowly.
I will hoard a bit.
What is that sound?
My ears have gone straight up.
I will freeze and look first.
Is that aimed at me?
My hind legs are already tensed.
I had better get ready to run.
I have noted that shadow.
Being watched makes my hind legs tense.
Forget the grass; I am leaving.
Move away quickly.
My ears stay pointed that way.
My ears turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 两只耳朵全压向你那边。
lines.en: Both my ears are pinned your way.
I crouch and load my hind legs.
I crouch my body down.
I am ready to jump.
Upwind, I catch your scent.
How much farther?
I keep changing direction.
Once I run, you cannot catch me.
A big rabbit can kick too.
My hind legs shoot out.
My hind legs kick into your knee.
I butt you and hop away.
My claws raked once.
Do not grab my ears.
I spin and kick again.
More force than you expected, yes?
I back off, ready to spring.
You got the worst of it. Go.

lines.zh: 草丛一开，我落在田埂上。
lines.en: The grass parts; I land on the field ridge.

lines.zh: 个头比一般兔子大一圈。
lines.en: I am a size up from an ordinary rabbit.
My ears come out first.

lines.zh: 我一落地，尘土就扬起来。
lines.en: The moment I land, dust rises.
I land on soft grass.
The grass here looks decent.

lines.zh: 我从《我的世界：地球》来的。
lines.en: I came over from Minecraft Earth.
Hop by hop, here I am.
That thud was me.
I look around.
Fire! The grass is catching.
I landed at a bad angle.
Water is at my ears, and I am frightened.
The boom has left my ears numb.
Something has sunk into my leg.
This feeling makes me shiver.
The grass is gone and my belly is empty.
The thunder cracked right beside me.
There is not even grass here.
